channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Five people killed in Russian missile attack on Ukraine’s Kharkiv region
item.description: A Russian missile attack on Ukraine's Kharkiv region killed five people and injured several others. At least 10 houses were struck by the missiles. Local governor says several injured in the attack with at least 10 houses struck by Russian missiles.

item.title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: A suspected virus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship has resulted in three deaths. The World Health Organization confirmed one case of hantavirus infection and is investigating five more suspected cases.

item.title: WEX board deal ends bitter proxy battle with activist Impactive
item.description: WEX's board deal with activist Impactive ended a bitter proxy battle. Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. WEX board deal ends bitter proxy battle with activist Impactive.

item.title: Iran claims it struck US warship in Strait of Hormuz, American navy denies charges
item.description: Iran claimed it struck a US warship in the Strait of Hormuz, but the American navy denied the charges. The incident escalated tensions between the two nations. Iran claims it struck US warship in Strait of Hormuz, American navy denies charges.

item.title: War preparations under way in Iran as Hormuz tensions with US escalate
item.description: Iran began war preparations amid escalating tensions with the US over the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian media reported a US warship was struck, but Washington denied the incident. Amid stalled talks and sparring over key waterway, Iranian media say US warship struck, but Washington denies incident.

item.title: Trump’s ‘Project Freedom’: Can US navy ‘guide’ stuck ships out of Hormuz?
item.description: US President Trump announced 'Project Freedom' to guide stuck ships out of the Strait of Hormuz. The plan's implementation remains unclear. Trump says US navy will free up ships stranded in the Gulf, but it remains unclear how the campaign will be implemented.

item.title: Iran Threatens Ships Over Trump Plan to Break Iran’s Blockade
item.description: Iranian military officials warned that ships attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz without permission would be at risk, amid tensions over the US plan to break Iran's blockade. A senior Iranian military official warned that any vessel that tried to cross the Strait of Hormuz without permission would be “at risk.”.

item.title: Chile landfill tops global list of methane emitters in UN report
item.description: A Chilean landfill is the world's largest emitter of methane, according to a UN report. Chile landfill tops global list of methane emitters in UN report Reuters.

item.title: GameStop's $56 billion eBay bid stokes investor doubts as shares lag offer
item.description: GameStop's $56 billion bid for eBay has raised investor doubts, with the company's shares lagging the offer. GameStop's $56 billion eBay bid stokes investor doubts as shares lag offer.

item.title: UAE Says Iran Launched Drone Attack on ADNOC Tanker In Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran launched a drone attack on an ADNOC-affiliated tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with no reported injuries. No injuries were reported in the drone attack on the ADNOC-affiliated tanker.

item.title: Singapore and New Zealand sign deal to keep supply chains open
item.description: Singapore and New Zealand have signed a deal to maintain open supply chains, amid efforts to mitigate the impact of global disruptions. Singapore and New Zealand sign deal to keep supply chains open Nikkei Asia.

item.title: Iran Nobel laureate Mohammadi needs urgent heart treatment in Tehran, brother says
item.description: Iranian Nobel laureate Mohammadi requires urgent heart treatment in Tehran. His brother stated the need for medical attention. Iran Nobel laureate Mohammadi needs urgent heart treatment in Tehran, brother says.

item.title: Outgoing Indian envoy meets Bangladesh FM, discusses bilateral ties
item.description: Outgoing Indian envoy Mr. Verma met Bangladesh's Foreign Minister to discuss bilateral ties. He reaffirmed India's commitment to strengthening cooperation with Bangladesh. Mr. Verma reaffirmed India’s commitment to work closely with the people and government of Bangladesh to further strengthen people-centric cooperation across all sectors.

item.title: China invokes anti-sanctions law to counter US blacklisting of refiners
item.description: China invoked an anti-sanctions law to counter the US blacklisting of Chinese refiners. The law allows Beijing to retaliate against entities enforcing sanctions. China invokes anti-sanctions law to counter US blacklisting of refiners.

item.title: US Military Says No Navy Ships Have Been Hit In Strait Of Hormuz
item.description: The US military denied that any Navy ships were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian state media had reported that a US frigate was targeted by two missiles. Iranian state media reported a US frigate was targeted by two missiles (File).

item.title: 2026 World Press Freedom Day
item.description: The 2026 World Press Freedom Day event will highlight the importance of media freedom. UN agencies and war correspondents will share their perspectives on press freedom and its challenges. Media freedom is not a given and its absence frequently leaves communities and vulnerable individuals in danger.

item.title: Modi's BJP conquers Bengal, one of India's toughest political frontiers
item.description: India's BJP, led by Modi, won in West Bengal, a key state. This victory could change the state's politics and the future of Modi's party. West Bengal’s verdict could reshape not just the state’s politics, but the future trajectory of Modi’s BJP.

item.title: Japan, Indonesia Seal Defence Pact, Upgrade Bilateral Ties
item.description: Japan and Indonesia upgraded their bilateral ties with a defence pact. The agreement aims to strengthen cooperation between the two nations. Japan, Indonesia Seal Defence Pact, Upgrade Bilateral Ties StratNews Global.

item.title: Coach Marcelino to leave Villarreal at end of season
item.description: Villarreal's coach Marcelino will leave at the end of the season. His departure was announced by the club. Coach Marcelino to leave Villarreal at end of season.

item.title: ‘Israel is not implementing the ceasefire agreement in Gaza’
item.description: Israel was accused of not implementing the Gaza ceasefire agreement. Tensions remain high in the region. ‘Israel is not implementing the ceasefire agreement in Gaza’.
